recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-5878. If current implementers need List to reference fulfilled workflow requests, handle that through a separate List tracker rather than carrying forward this already-applied DocumentManifest issue.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 request to add DocumentManifest.related 0..* with identifier and Reference(Any) children, add related-id and related-ref search support, and shorten the DocumentManifest.identifier definition.
initial_application: Git commit 9838cb4a889645d232f78878b97271ba900acf8a explicitly applied "DocumentManifest support for related request [5878]" by adding DocumentManifest.related, DocumentManifest.related.ids, DocumentManifest.related.refs, and relatedids/relatedrefs search parameters to the historical spreadsheet source.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini omits documentmanifest from active resources, lists DocumentManifest under removed resources, comments old DocumentManifest workgroup/TLA/status entries, and maps DocumentManifest to List. source/history.html also records DocumentManifest as removed with a List replacement. Later Published FHIR-33021 and its linked Zulip thread document the retirement rationale: IHE MHD moved to List and no other current use cases were known. FHIR-39006 then moved XDS mappings and an XDS example into List.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing DocumentManifest.related is outside current build scope because DocumentManifest source was deleted; adding a request/related element to List would require a separate current-release model decision.
